name: 一次装到位
description: 给 PI-Desktop 写插件并装到位：先分清 Desktop 和 PI CLI，再按官方模板写 manifest/技能/面板，然后 Scaffold → Check → Pack → 插件页装 .piplug。不是给 Windows 桌面装软件。

en.name: PI-Desktop Install Guard
en.description: Write and install PI-Desktop plugins in one pass: official templates and marketplace fields, then Scaffold → Check → Pack → install the .piplug. Distinguishes PI-Desktop from PI CLI. Not a Windows desktop-layout installer.
en.safetyNotes: Instruction documents only. Does not edit the plugin registry, click Install, start MCP servers, read secrets, or touch the Windows desktop.
